evidence.title: Nestle–Aland 28, German Bible Society online running text
evidence.scope: John 1:1–18, all 252 lexical tokens and displayed punctuation read. No printed critical apparatus was accessed.
evidence.reproduction: Full NA28 text is not redistributed. Reproduced Greek forms derive from the separately attributed open SBLGNT witness.

evidence.title: SBLGNT official text, John 1:1–18
evidence.scope: All 18 verses compared as a word-form witness. Agreement in lexical sequence does not establish agreement in punctuation, apparatus or the rest of John.

evidence.title: SBLGNT edition-comparison apparatus, John 1:15,16,18
evidence.scope: Read only these three entries. Reports edition readings at 1:15, 1:16 and 1:18; not a manuscript or NA28-apparatus collation.

evidence.title: MorphGNT SBLGNT tokenization, lemmas and parsing
evidence.scope: 252 tokens; candidate tags considered in passage context by the assistant. Ambiguous 1:9 token 10 receives an explicit alternative. Dataset tags are evidence to examine, not independent approval.

evidence.title: Middle Liddell, καταλαμβάνω, Perseus Scaife ATLAS
evidence.scope: General lexical entry read: physical seizure/overtaking and cognitive apprehension. Contextual selection in John is the translator’s inference.

evidence.title: LSJ, ἀντί, Perseus Scaife ATLAS, A.III and the John 1:16 example
evidence.scope: Substitution sense and the entry’s increasing-grace interpretation of John 1:16 consulted. Neither is treated as an automatic final interpretation.

evidence.title: Perseus Scaife ATLAS headword, μονογενής
evidence.scope: Only the short headword gloss only/single child was accessible. The full LSJ entry and a specialist NT entry were not successfully accessed; this does not complete the monogenēs study.

evidence.title: Inherited Saints John verse records
evidence.scope: First 18 verse units read and preserved for exact before/after comparison.

greek_text.modifications: John 1:1–18 extracted and segmented. Apparatus marks removed from token forms; no lexical reading substituted. The publisher’s NA28 display was consulted separately as the governing passage reading.
